prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ summarizeQueues }`. `summarizeQueues(samples, patterns)` receives an array of records shaped `{ name, active, queued, rejected }` and an optional string or array of strings. Every numeric field must be a non-negative integer and every name must be a non-empty string; otherwise throw `TypeError`. A pattern matches when it equals the name or ends in `*` and its preceding text is a name prefix. An omitted pattern, `undefined`, or an empty pattern array selects all records. Reject all other pattern values with `TypeError`. Preserve input order, include each record at most once even if several patterns match, and return fresh objects with an added `load` field equal to `active + queued`. Do not mutate or alias any input object. Empty samples return `[]`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
